com.ibm.cos.v2.http

Class SdkHttpClientDefaultTestSuite

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.http.SdkHttpClientDefaultTestSuite

  • public abstract class SdkHttpClientDefaultTestSuite
extends Object
    A set of tests validating that the functionality implemented by a SdkHttpClient.

    This is used by an HTTP plugin implementation by extending this class and implementing the abstract methods to provide this suite with a testable HTTP client implementation.
